title: 指出问题时，怎样保持直接又尊重
topic: 读 Wells Fargo 员工行为期待，练习提出清楚反馈、承担问题并给出可跟踪的下一步。

source.title: Our culture
source.type: Wells Fargo 面向员工的公司行为期待

fullTextHeadings.1: A company culture we can all take pride in

paragraphs: Share clear, honest, direct feedback individually with your colleagues and in meetings so they are as productive as possible. Embrace respectful debate and dialogue.
Set high standards for how you treat colleagues, customers, and clients. If you see a problem, take ownership or get support to make things right.
Be clear about goals, track and report on them, and deliver a quality product on time. Use data to make decisions. Act with a sense of urgency.
translations: 与同事单独沟通或在会议中提供清晰、诚实、直接的反馈，让合作更有效。以尊重的方式展开讨论和辩论。
以高标准对待同事、客户和服务对象。发现问题时，要主动负责，或寻求支持把事情处理好。
明确目标、跟踪并汇报进展，按时交付高质量成果。用数据作决定，并及时行动。
fullTextParagraphs: A company culture we can all take pride in

We have adopted a set of principles to anchor our company culture. We call them our Company Expectations, and they apply to every single employee, at every level, and in every role. They guide how we conduct ourselves, work with our colleagues, and make decisions.
Contribute to Wells Fargo’s transformation by doing what’s right, doing it well, and leading with an enterprise mindset.
Share clear, honest, direct feedback individually with your colleagues and in meetings so they are as productive as possible. Embrace respectful debate and dialogue.
Set high standards for how you treat colleagues, customers, and clients. If you see a problem, take ownership or get support to make things right.
Be clear about goals, track and report on them, and deliver a quality product on time. Use data to make decisions. Act with a sense of urgency.
Ask others for feedback; dedicate the time and effort to learn and grow. Take personal accountability for understanding and delivering on your goals and commitments.
verifiedFacts: Wells Fargo 的公开资料明确介绍了“指出问题时，怎样保持直接又尊重”相关的工作做法。
练习情境为虚构职场训练，不代表公司真实员工对话。

notes.meaning: 以尊重的方式讨论和辩论
notes.explain: 尊重地讨论分歧，针对观点和证据沟通，不把批评变成人身攻击。
notes.example: We can have a respectful debate about the proposal.

notes.explain: take ownership 表示主动负责后续行动，不只是承认问题存在。
notes.example: I’ll take ownership of the issue and follow up.

notes.explain: track and report on 要说明跟踪什么、向谁或何时汇报。
notes.example: I’ll track and report on progress each week.

scenario.title: Wells Fargo工作场景练习（虚构）
english: A colleague’s report uses an outdated figure. The client review is tomorrow, and no one has confirmed who will correct the chart.
Give direct, respectful feedback, take ownership of the follow-up, and state when you will report back.
chinese: 同事的报告用了过期数据。客户评审在明天，但还没人确认谁来修正图表。
用尊重的方式指出问题，承担跟进责任，并说明何时汇报。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给同事写一条消息：指出报告中的图表用了旧数据，说明这会影响明天的客户评审，并提出一起核对最新版数据。
firstAttempt.sample: I noticed the chart uses an older figure, which could affect tomorrow’s client review. Could we check it against the latest data today? I’ll take ownership of updating the chart and report back by 3 p.m.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先独立组织信息，再比较示范中的目标、行动和时间表达。
